faq.question: What are the best rooftop cafes in Kathmandu?
faq.answer: The top rooftop cafes in Kathmandu include Nepalaya Rooftop Restaurant in Thamel (4.7★), Samaya Rooftop Garden for its tranquil terrace, Roadhouse Cafe Boudha for stupa views, and View Brew Cafe in Patan for panoramic valley vistas. Most rooftop spots are concentrated in Thamel and around Boudhanath Stupa.

faq.question: Can you see the Himalayas from Kathmandu rooftop cafes?
faq.answer: On clear days (especially October–March), several rooftop cafes offer distant views of the Himalayan range. View Brew in Patan and Drishya near Patan Durbar Square have some of the best mountain views. Air quality and clouds affect visibility — mornings tend to be clearest.

faq.question: How much does a meal cost at a Kathmandu rooftop cafe?
faq.answer: Most rooftop cafes in Kathmandu are very affordable by Western standards. A coffee costs NPR 200–400 ($1.50–$3), a meal NPR 500–1,500 ($3.75–$11), and cocktails NPR 600–1,200 ($4.50–$9). Premium spots like Mezze by Roadhouse and Penthouse are at the higher end but still reasonable.

faq.question: Which rooftop cafes have the best stupa views?
faq.answer: For Boudhanath Stupa views, Roadhouse Cafe Boudha and Boudha Stupa View Rooftop Restaurant are the top picks — both overlook the massive white dome from directly above. For Swayambhunath (Monkey Temple) views, look for cafes near the base of the hill.

faq.question: Are Kathmandu rooftop cafes open year-round?
faq.answer: Most rooftop cafes operate year-round, though the experience varies by season. October–March offers the clearest mountain views and dry weather. During monsoon season (June–September), some rooftop areas may be partially covered or less pleasant due to rain, but many spots have covered sections.

faq.question: Is Thamel the best area for rooftop cafes?
faq.answer: Thamel has the highest concentration of rooftop cafes and is the most convenient area for tourists. However, Boudha (around Boudhanath Stupa) and Patan (Lalitpur) offer rooftop experiences with better views and less tourist congestion. Durbar Marg has upscale options like Mezze and Penthouse.
